notes: 4 photos, all printed menu boards. Photo 1 is the main laminated menu (Chef's Specialties, Seafood, Beef/Chicken, Pork/Lamb, Chow Mein/Noodle, Vegetable, Fried Rice, and photo dried-pot specials). Photo 2 is the individual hot pot menu (14 numbered pots with full contents). Photo 3 is a lunch special card (12 items, all $16, Mon-Fri 11am-2pm, includes rice/egg roll/soup). Photo 4 is an older/lower-priced photo of the same Chef's Specialties/Seafood/Beef-Chicken sections as photo 1; merged as duplicates except two items not seen elsewhere (Tomato Beef, Salt and Pepper Chicken), added at photo 4's prices.
